ModuleName: 10 - Machine Learning, Automation, Version Control, and Responsible AI

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the module's core topics—supervised machine learning concepts, scikit-learn workflows, engineering automation and parameter sweeps, version control, and responsible AI—serving as a navigation guide for learners to understand what will be covered and for instructors to align their teaching materials.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: This module topics page outlines the key subject areas covered in Module 10—including supervised machine learning (regression and classification), automation, version control, and responsible AI—and serves as a navigational overview for learners to understand what concepts they will study throughout the module.

Artifacts.Name: Responsible AI Integration in Engineering Practice
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers the professional and ethical obligations engineers have when using AI tools such as large language models and code-generation assistants, guiding learners in critically evaluating, validating, and responsibly integrating AI outputs into engineering work.

Artifacts.Name: Foundations of Supervised Machine Learning
Artifacts.Description: This reading introduces the core concepts of supervised machine learning—including labeled training data, model fitting, prediction, and generalization—with engineering-relevant examples, serving as a conceptual foundation for learners before applying ML techniques.

Artifacts.Name: Machine Learning with scikit-learn
Artifacts.Description: This reading explains how to use the scikit-learn Python library to execute the full machine learning workflow—data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and result interpretation—providing learners and instructors with a practical implementation reference.

Artifacts.Name: Engineering Automation and Parameter Sweep Pipelines
Artifacts.Description: This reading explains how to design and implement engineering automation scripts and parameter sweep pipelines in Python to replace repetitive simulation and data-processing tasks, teaching learners to systematically explore design spaces and automate report generation.

Artifacts.Name: Git and GitHub Version Control
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers the fundamentals of Git version control and GitHub collaboration workflows—including commits, branches, and repositories—so learners can manage code changes and collaborate on engineering scripts and automation projects professionally.
